en: This route deliberately narrows Antelope Island to one known place for the evening. Antelope Island faces both the dark lake and the glow of the Wasatch Front; White Rock Bay campground area is the decision point. A campground-based night resolves gate and vehicle questions more honestly than a generic shoreline pin; setup at White Rock Bay campground area waits for that answer. This route makes White Rock Bay campground area the only observing stop so attention stays with the sky and the known return. Bridger Bay campground area is useful for a different date after its own current check.

A compact setup matters at White Rock Bay campground area because the visitor footprint is shared. Wildlife distance and closed shoreline habitat remain non-negotiable after dark. Begin with an empty-handed look at the horizon. Equipment is added only after the safe footprint, shared paths and final packing sequence are clear; this is checked before unloading at White Rock Bay campground area.
